sentences: A randomized logspace machine has very little working memory, but its power also depends on how it accesses random bits.
Allowing two-way access lets it revisit its random tape instead of consuming each bit once.
The source asks whether this model can be simulated deterministically in subexponential time.
Its results for machines making a controlled number of passes do not settle unrestricted two-way access.
Understanding the difference would clarify how reusable randomness affects small-space computation and why conventional logspace derandomization techniques do not automatically apply.
